WORKSHEET · CLASS 32 · AGES 4–5

Stay Safe Worksheet for Ages 4–5

A safety worksheet for age 4: circle the safe choice, match household objects to their safe actions, cross out the unsafe action, trace STAY SAFE and draw a happy face beside the safe habit — on screen or on paper.

THE WORKSHEET

The full sheet, exactly as the artist drew it.

See the whole sheet, download the original file or print it from your browser. Want your child to solve it on screen first? The interactive version lives at /preschool/life-skills/stay-safe/ — same sheet, drawing layer included.

← Bedtime RoutinePrevious worksheetHelp at Home →Next worksheet
HOW TO USE IT

The five steps on the sheet.

  1. 1

    Circle

    Look at each pair of pictures and circle the safe choice.

  2. 2

    Match

    Draw a line from each household object to the safe way we handle it.

  3. 3

    Cross out

    Find the unsafe action in each row and cross it out with a big X.

  4. 4

    Trace

    Trace the words STAY SAFE with your steadiest pencil.

  5. 5

    Draw

    Read the four habits and draw a happy face beside each safe one.

WHERE THIS FITS

The class behind it.

This worksheet belongs to Class 32 — Life Skills & Good Habits on the Learning Path, and the whole collection lives at /worksheets/life-skills/. One finished sheet is a full session — print it, solve it together, and let the fridge door be the gallery.

TAKE IT TO THE TABLE

Download & print.

The download keeps the original WebP picture, full size (1414×2000, A4 portrait). Print opens your browser’s print dialog with just the sheet — nothing stored.

REACTIONS

How did it go?
